_note: Seeded by scripts/seed-retailers.ts, matched on slug. Whether a store is read is Rutu’s switch under Me, Finder; "enabled" here only sets a newly added store’s starting state. A Wellington store is shown as ‘try on at’ only once verified is true, and an address is only filled in after checking it on the retailer’s own site, which `source` names; none is verified yet. Shopify rate-limits /products.json per client address across every Shopify shop, so the finder reads stores one after another, never side by side. retailers.name: LSKD
retailers.notes: Links only by default: a Gold Coast activewear label, one Shopify shop in AUD that ships to NZ. A pasted link is read from /products/<handle>.js like any Shopify store, and a saved one is re-read each night. It starts switched off: its robots.txt disallows /collections/*/*, so no women’s collection feed, and a whole-catalogue read of about 4,900 products is answered 429 for over an hour. Its stores are in Australia and Auckland.

retailers.name: Uniqlo AU
retailers.notes: Links only, for pieces she owns or wants: Uniqlo has no NZ online store and does not ship here (its AU help centre says so), and the site is not Shopify, so the finder never walks it and it has no switch on /you/finder. A pasted link is read from its own region's store when it has one here (Uniqlo US), and from the Australian page for the same product otherwise, since it is the store added first on uniqlo.com. The page's HTML carries the product (colours, sizes, price, photos) in window.__PRELOADED_STATE__; per-size stock is not in it. Each colour is stored as its own product, as Country Road lists them. Probed 2026-11-05: robots.txt allows /au/en/products/, and the page answers the finder's own User-Agent.

retailers.name: Uniqlo US
retailers.notes: Links only, like Uniqlo AU, for a link copied from the US site: many US products and colours are not sold in Australia, and the Australian page for them is a 404 (checked 2026-11-05: three of six US shirts). Read from the US page in USD, shown in NZD. Does not ship to NZ. Probed 2026-11-05: robots.txt allows /us/en/products/, and the page answers the finder's own User-Agent with the same preloaded state as AU's.

retailers.name: Lululemon
retailers.notes: Added by hand only. The site is Salesforce Commerce Cloud, not Shopify, and Cloudflare answers every request but robots.txt with a challenge page (403), sitemap included, to the finder's own User-Agent; getting past it would mean posing as a browser, which the finder does not do. Its affiliate feed (Commission Factory) needs a public site to promote it from. So a Lululemon link pasted on her wishlist opens a form for the photo, name, kind, price, colour and size, and the price is never checked. Probed 2026-11-05. Its Wellington store could not be checked on its own site, so none is shown.
